name: gizza-ai/percentage-calculator
summary: Percent of, what percent, percent change, apply change, and share of total.

tool.description: Answer everyday percentage questions from plain numbers: percent of a base, what percent one number is of another, percent change, apply a percent change, or a value's share of a total.

base.description: The base amount the percentage acts on (percent_of, apply_change).

value.description: The value whose share of the total you want (percent_of_total).
